note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #34, Q4 2024 Harassment; byte-identical to Bookmark #25 apart from the input file and output name) keeps INEGI columns bp4_1_1..bp4_1_9 from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_1224.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); code 9 set missing (lines 220-222 for bp4_1_1..3 outside 2024Q1, 232-237 for bp4_1_4..9). mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's Q4 data dictionary labels each BP4_1_n 'Situaciones de acoso: <situation>', and after stripping that prefix 9/9 labels are character-identical (whitespace-normalised) to the shipped item_text and to questionnaire 4.1 options 1-9 in the same order. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 9 live item vectors reproduce the raw INEGI Q4 2024 CSV after the .do's recode -- 18/18 item x level counts match (bp4_1_1 1/2 = 2085/21351, bp4_1_2 155/23279, bp4_1_3 330/23105, bp4_1_4 1125/22308, bp4_1_5 61/23376, bp4_1_6 509/22927, bp4_1_7 460/22970, bp4_1_8 853/22573, bp4_1_9 65/23363); code 9 counts dropped 15/17/16/18/14/15/21/25/23 (164 cells); no blanks, no skip routing into 4.1 (raw 23451 rows; live 210895 rows = 9 x 23451 - 164, over 23439 ids = 23451 - 12 respondents coded 9 on all nine items). Live counts from the irw_fetch() copy table_context.R had already cached locally; no second export. Words: item_text / section_prompt / instructions are the administered Q4 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Built from the batch_678 Q2 table: all 11 Spanish strings (CP4, 4.1 stem, 9 options) plus 'Si'/'No' are found verbatim in the Q4 PDF's text layer (p.6) after whitespace normalisation, and a 150-dpi render of p.6 was read to confirm -- Section IV wording is unchanged between Q2 and Q4, so the Q2 English was reused verbatim for every field. Only the instrument name changes (segundo -> cuarto trimestre). Kept as printed: '(a)'/'(o)' gender fills, 'videos' in item 8 vs accented 'vídeos' in item 9, both as printed, 'etcetera' in items 4 and 8. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space. Stripped: question number 4.1, option numbers, dot leaders and I__I boxes, interviewer direction 'MUESTRE LA TARJETA "D" Y REGISTRE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE A CADA OPCION'. Tarjeta D is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure: one section (all nine items are options of question 4.1); CP4 in instructions, the 4.1 stem in section_prompt, as in batch_678. Options: 1 = 'Si', 2 = 'No' printed in the questionnaire and identical in all 9 catalogos; 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Step 3b: live items match question 4.1 exactly (9 = 9); same shape as Q2 in print, dictionary, raw CSV and .do. Differences from Q2 are in INEGI's dictionary only: Q4 prefixes labels 'Situaciones de acoso:' (Q2 'Experiencias de victimizacion personal:') and its labels now agree with the questionnaire where Q2's did not (items 4/8 'etcetera', item 6 'ofendida(o) o atemorizada(o)'). The IRW dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2024 Q4 (file suffix 1224, PER=0424) wave -- same defect as the siblings. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation, reused from batch_678); INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2024, cuarto trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section IV (question 4.1) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
